text:
Maria: Wow, that all-hands hit different tonight. Standing ovation :clap: :tada:
Kevin: Soundtrack choice was immaculate. Who picked the ukulele outro? :guitar:
Sophia: Not me, but +1 to whoever did. Also popcorn emoji spam incoming 🍿
Devon: I brought actual popcorn to my desk and tripped over enthusiasm. 10/10 would trip again.
Leo: Can we petition for 'end with ukulele' as a company ritual? I will fundraise snacks.
Jules: Snack poll: popcorn 🍿, chips 🥔, or nothing because snacks are for the brave? React with :one: :two: :three: to vote.
Tara: :one: for popcorn. Also new team chant idea: 'Go Redwood!' (yes corgi gif later)
OpsBot: Reminder: next all-hands will be 2025-06-12 17:00 UTC. Add to calendar with `/allhands add`
Maria: Also kudos to Engineering for the latency graphs — they were soothing. :heart:
Kevin: Shoutout to DevEx for the demo not catching fire. Miracles happen. :pray:
Sophia: Who can supply the corgi for the post-all-hands gif chain? Asking for a friend.
Devon: I have a terrible polaroid of a corgi, ready to ruin the thread. Uploading in 3...2...1...
Devon: [uploaded corgi.gif] :corgi: (gif was indeed terrible and delightful)
Leo: This thread is basically my new bedtime story. Goodnight all. :sleeping:
Jules: Also, immediate poll result snapshot: popcorn is winning by a landslide (very scientific).
Tara: Ok I'm adding 'ukulele outro' to agenda for next all-hands under 'traditions'. :memo:
Maria: Love y'all. Great energy. See you at the snack table. :sparkles:
